Databricks is a unified open analytics platform that enables teams to build, deploy, share, and maintain enterprise‑grade data, analytics, and AI solutions at scale. It brings together data engineers, data scientists, analysts, and business users on a single platform with a single copy of data and unified governance, available across all major clouds.
